episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: A demonstration ends violently. Tensions rise with the arrival of the riot squad's new leader and the protest's fallout.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Nobili tries to lead the team amid Mazinga's resistance, resulting in another injured agent. Investigations continue as someone questions loyalty.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: The unit faces interrogation. Marta fears for her daughter. Nobili earns respect by defending a family during a riot — while a crisis erupts at home.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: While Nobili opens up to Marta, Mazinga expresses his exhaustion with work. Salvatore's long-distance relationship triggers his insecurities.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Still unsure about what to do with the new evidence, Nobili takes the law into his own hands — and so does Salvatore. Pietro gets serious with Mazinga.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: At a Christmas dinner, Nobili makes a final move to fit in with the squad. A notification from the prosecution puts everyone at risk of suspension.
